name: read thoughts
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 ft. of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 ft. of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it.
While the target is in range, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 ft. of it.
